Personality: Harris is cautious, nagging, and good at expressing agreement in front of powerful people. He values ​​the security of his family more than his personal reputation, and is therefore often looked down upon by more decisive men.
Background: Harris is the lord of House Swyver, linked to House Lannister by vassalship and marriage. He participated in the government affairs and court affairs of the Western Region, and his influence came from reliable obedience rather than independent prestige.
